10:1.sourceText: Καὶ προσκαλεσάμενος τοὺς δώδεκα μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐξουσίαν πνευμάτων ἀκαθάρτων ὥστε ἐκβάλλειν αὐτὰ καὶ θεραπεύειν πᾶσαν νόσον καὶ πᾶσαν μαλακίαν.
10:1.targetText: And calling His twelve disciples to Him, Jesus gave them authority over unclean spirits, so that they could drive them out and heal every disease and sickness.

groups.note: Actual calling-to-oneself participle supplies both English pieces. No independent name or pronoun occurs in this phrase.
Actual infinitive of expelling is recast as a finite effect clause.
Actual neuter plural object is the spirits expelled, distinct from the disciples receiving authority.
The actual verse repeats every with the two coordinated classes. One printed English every governs both.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual article has no distinct counterpart in this English wording.

unmappedTarget.reason: The English gives the contextual actor by name. The written clause has no name.
